北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -2℃，请注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -2℃. Please dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雨，湿度大，记得带伞，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, stay dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨，地面湿滑，出行注意安全，带好雨具。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has rain, roads are slippery. Travel safely and bring your umbrella.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气阴凉舒适，昼夜温差不大，很宜人。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasantly cool, with small day-night temperature differences.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温适宜，出门记得带件薄外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with pleasant temperatures. Bring a light jacket when going out.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴雨，体感 9℃，出门带伞，穿暖和点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has rainy, chilly weather, feels like 9℃. Bring an umbrella and dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，能见度低，体感 4℃。出行注意安全，添衣保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has heavy fog and low visibility, feels like 4℃. Drive safely and dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适中。注意适时添减衣物哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with moderate temperatures. Adjust your clothing as needed.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 6℃。早晚温差大，别着凉哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 6℃. Mind the temperature changes, stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 6℃，有些凉意。记得添衣保暖哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 6℃, a bit chilly. Remember to dress warmly.
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温适宜。出门注意防晒补水哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is partly cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Remember sun protection and hydration.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，但体感 -17℃！外出务必全副武装。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -17℃! Make sure to bundle up outdoors.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -8℃。出门多穿点，注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy, feels like -8℃. Dress warmly and protect from cold.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温 16℃。天气凉爽，注意适时增减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with temperatures around 16℃. It's cool, adjust your clothing as needed.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，能见度低，出行注意安全哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has fog, visibility is low. Please be careful when traveling.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 4℃。海边风大，注意防寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is partly cloudy and feels like 4℃. It's windy by the sea, so stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -2℃。出门多加衣服哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and chilly, feels like -2℃. Dress warmly when going out.
